info.title: B031 local-dev metadata foundation
info.description: O03/O04 dataset metadata subset. Optional MetadataService shares B030 local-only auth authority. Project POST invokes the same durable metadata commit service as future B033. Import intents30min do not publish a dataset; renewal preserves logical IDs and queries durable identity first. Cursor pages are bounded live lists, not B080 snapshot manifests. Dataset/version write HTTP endpoints and real artifact storage belong B032/B033; current default artifact authority fails closed. Synthetic fixture operations do not enable product engines. Config hash binds canonical {parseConfig,operationSnapshot} for dataset creation.
